purpose: Freeze the upstream facts used by the 2026-09-19 public audit; source URLs remain convenience links.

receipts.claim: RustSec marks glib versions from 0.15.0 up to but excluding 0.20.0 as affected; 0.20.0 and later are patched.
Microsoft documents the WebView2 user-data folder as browser-data storage and states that controls using the same UDF share one WebView2 session, including across host apps in the same logon session.
receipts.bounded_quote: A WebView2 control shares its WebView2 session with any other WebView2 control that uses the same UDF.

receipts.claim: Microsoft requires one CoUninitialize for each successful CoInitialize or CoInitializeEx call on a thread, including calls that return S_FALSE.
receipts.bounded_quote: A thread must call CoUninitialize once for each successful call it has made to the CoInitialize or CoInitializeEx function

receipts.claim: Microsoft's COM initialization guidance requires balancing each successful CoInitializeEx with CoUninitialize before the thread exits.
receipts.bounded_quote: For every successful call to CoInitializeEx, you must call CoUninitialize before the thread exits.
